description: New follows with full enrichment: AI classification + custom rules + custom tags + filtering. The most powerful signal endpoint. Use sector/keyword/entity_type filters to query like "show me all stablecoin neobanks my tracked VCs followed this week".

cursor.description: Opaque watermark from a previous response's next_cursor. Resumes exactly where that run stopped, so a scheduled job that retries neither double counts nor drops records. Overrides since. Pass it back unmodified; save it only AFTER processing the response.

keyword.description: Search keyword (matches username, name, bio, sector)

scope.description: Whose follows to read: "tracked" (default, your tracked accounts), "network" (the whole Frontrun network, paid Pro plans) or "list:<id>" (one of your lists from frontrun_lists, with its sectors).

tag.description: Filter by custom tag or rule name

username.description: Filter to a specific tracked account

name: frontrun_enriched_follows
